LanguageData.RL_StructuralFloor.label: structural floor
LanguageData.RL_StructuralFloor.description: A load-bearing floor laid on the finished roof of the layer below. That roof has to stay intact.
LanguageData.RL_OpenAir.label: open air
LanguageData.RL_OpenAir.description: Space on an upper layer that no floor has been laid on yet. Nothing can stand or walk here.
LanguageData.RL_SpaceAir.label: space
LanguageData.RL_SpaceAir.description: Space on an upper layer of an orbiting ship that no floor has been laid on yet. It looks like the vacuum outside the hull. Nothing can stand or walk here.

LanguageData.RL_Isolation.description: Storage coordinates reserved between logical layers. They are not real space.
